title: Problem
问题
html:
Search-enabled agents can retrieve a benchmark question together with its ground-truth answer from the web, then copy it instead of solving it. This invalidates an evaluation even if the model was never trained on the test set.

The paper names this failure search-time contamination and audits search logs on HLE, SimpleQA, and GPQA. It tests whether blocking a major source changes performance and proposes reporting practices that preserve searchable evidence for later inspection.

可搜索网络的智能体可能在网页上同时检索到基准题目和标准答案，随后直接复制而非求解。即使模型训练时从未见过测试集，这也会使评测失效。

论文将这一失效称为“搜索时污染”，在 HLE、SimpleQA 和 GPQA 上审计搜索日志，测试屏蔽主要来源是否改变表现，并提出保留可检索证据以便事后审计的报告规范。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is a contamination definition at retrieval time: an agent is contaminated when search surfaces the evaluated question or a near duplicate together with its answer. The authors inspect search-agent trajectories for such sources, identify publicly hosted benchmark copies with labels, and intervene by blocking Hugging Face before re-running the affected subset. The paper’s public artifact is its complete experimental logs for audit; it is not a new training dataset. Its central change from training-data contamination work is to treat retrieval provenance and the agent’s search trace as part of the evaluation contract, because a held-out test item can become answer-visible only at inference time.

论文提出检索阶段的污染定义：当搜索结果出现被评测题目或其近似题，并同时给出答案时，智能体即被污染。作者检查搜索智能体轨迹中的这类来源，识别带标签的公开基准副本，并在屏蔽 Hugging Face 后重新运行受影响子集。其公开产物是供审计的完整实验日志，并非新的训练数据集。它相对训练数据污染研究的关键变化，是把检索来源关系和智能体搜索轨迹纳入评测契约，因为原本隔离的测试题可能只在推理时才变得“答案可见”。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Run searchable evaluation. Search-based agents answer HLE, SimpleQA, and GPQA items while their retrieved sources and reasoning logs are retained.
  1. Mark direct leakage. Inspect whether a source contains the test question or near duplicate together with the ground-truth answer; retain the URL and trajectory as evidence.
  1. Localize sources. Identify public dataset copies, including labeled Hugging Face repositories, among retrieved pages.
  1. Intervene. Block Hugging Face and re-evaluate contaminated items; compare accuracy with the original search setting.
  1. Audit disclosure. Release complete logs and report search configuration, blocked domains, timestamps, and the definition used to mark contamination. Other web sources remain a possible leakage path.

1. 运行可搜索评测。 搜索型智能体回答 HLE、SimpleQA 和 GPQA，保留检索来源与推理日志。
  1. 标记直接泄漏。 检查来源是否同时含测试题或近似题及标准答案，并保存 URL 与轨迹作为证据。
  1. 定位来源。 在检索页面中识别公开数据副本，包括带标签的 Hugging Face 仓库。
  1. 进行干预。 屏蔽 Hugging Face 后重新评测受污染题目，与原搜索设置的准确率比较。
  1. 公开审计信息。 发布完整日志，并报告搜索配置、屏蔽域名、时间戳和污染判定定义；其他网页仍可能构成泄漏路径。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Across HLE, SimpleQA, and GPQA, the study finds direct labeled-dataset retrieval for about 3% of questions. On the contaminated subset, blocking Hugging Face reduces accuracy by about 15% (abstract); the HLE comparison is reported as differing by up to 20%. This is an intervention on one accessible source and supports that retrieval can inflate those scores. It does not measure all web leakage or establish a universal contamination rate for other agents, dates, or search engines.
在 HLE、SimpleQA 和 GPQA 上，研究发现约 3% 的题目会直接检索到带标签的数据集。对受污染子集，屏蔽 Hugging Face 后准确率约下降 15%（摘要）；HLE 的比较差异最高报告为 20%。这是针对一个可访问来源的干预，支持检索会抬高该设置下的分数；它并未测量所有网页泄漏，也不能给出其他智能体、日期或搜索引擎的通用污染率。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Training-time contamination asks whether a test item entered model weights before evaluation. This paper changes the boundary to inference: a search tool can expose the answer after the benchmark is chosen. Search logs and domain blocking are not new evaluation tools; the new object is the answer-bearing retrieval event, tied to a replayable trajectory and a controlled source-removal comparison.
训练时污染追问测试题是否在评测前进入模型权重。本文把边界移到推理时：基准确定后，搜索工具仍可暴露答案。搜索日志和域名屏蔽不是新工具；新对象是携带答案的检索事件，并将它绑定到可重放轨迹和受控的来源移除对照。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Blocking Hugging Face cannot remove mirrors, cached copies, answer pages, or near-duplicate web sources, which the authors explicitly test as a remaining concern. Search results are time-dependent and may differ by provider, locale, query rewriting, and agent policy. Reuse should archive URLs and timestamps; a missing retrieved dataset page is not proof that a run was uncontaminated.
屏蔽 Hugging Face 不能移除镜像、缓存副本、答案页面或近似题来源，作者也将其作为剩余风险测试。搜索结果受时间影响，并会随提供商、地区、查询改写和智能体策略变化。复用时应归档 URL 和时间戳；没有检索到数据集页面，并不能证明一次运行没有污染。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Before evaluating a web-search agent, save its full search trace and scan retrieved pages for question–answer matches. Re-run flagged items with a documented blocklist and report both scores; the output is an auditable contamination ledger. Do not treat a single domain block as a clean-room evaluation when other answer-bearing pages remain reachable.
评测联网搜索智能体前，应保存完整检索轨迹，扫描页面是否同时匹配题目和答案。对被标记题目用记录在案的屏蔽名单重跑，并同时报告两种分数；最终产物是可审计的污染台账。若其他携带答案的页面仍可访问，不能把单一域名屏蔽视为隔离评测。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Decision. A held-out test can leak at retrieval time without entering model training.
  1. Mechanism. Preserve search trajectories, identify answer-bearing pages, then compare runs with the source blocked.
  1. Artifact. The authors release complete experiment logs, not a new benchmark dataset.
  1. Evidence. About 3% of audited questions directly found labeled datasets; blocking Hugging Face cut contaminated-subset accuracy by about 15%.
  1. Reuse. Report URLs, timestamps, and blocklists; web search cannot be presumed clean from one negative check.

1. 定位。 隔离测试题即使未进入训练，也可在检索时泄漏。
  1. 方法。 保留搜索轨迹，识别携带答案的页面，再比较屏蔽该来源前后的运行。
  1. 产物。 作者公开的是完整实验日志，不是新基准数据集。
  1. 证据。 约 3% 的审计题目直接找到带标签数据集；屏蔽 Hugging Face 后受污染子集准确率约降 15%。
  1. 复用。 报告 URL、时间戳和屏蔽名单；一次未发现泄漏不能证明网页搜索干净。
